items.quote: I don't consider myself very effective. I feel like I'm still wasting too much time on repetitive tasks and lack automation.
items.statement: I don't consider myself very effective.

items.quote: One of my new rules that I'm applying religiously every workday is planning the next day ahead.
items.statement: One of my new rules that I'm applying religiously every workday is planning the next day ahead.

items.quote: I keep sticky notes and a pencil on my nightstand, and before my nighttime reading, I jot down tomorrow's schedule with the points I have to complete.
items.statement: I keep sticky notes and a pencil on my nightstand, and before my nighttime reading, I jot down tomorrow's schedule.

items.quote: In the morning, I stick the note on the board in my kitchen first thing, and this way, I reread the tasks again.
items.statement: In the morning, I stick the note on the board in my kitchen first thing, and this way, I reread the tasks again.

items.quote: I believe the process of handwriting and rereading helps position it in long-term memory, at least for a day.
items.statement: I believe the process of handwriting and rereading helps position it in long-term memory, at least for a day.

items.quote: Plus, using a sticky note is convenient since my phone doesn't go with me to bed.
items.statement: Plus, using a sticky note is convenient since my phone doesn't go with me to bed.

items.quote: Do you have a better system?
items.statement: Do you have a better system?
